confound_note: KNOWN CONFOUND PRESENT. The baseline output explicitly cites a canon file belonging to the skill under test: '`08_AI_SKILL_SYSTEM\phd-dt-research-skills\_phd-canon\novelty-boundary.md` xep "sensor-to-BIM linking" va "IFC GlobalId as a persistent component identifier" vao danh sach classify as PRIOR ART by default, va dung dung cau hoi nay lam worked example.' This is the strongest form of the confound: the baseline reports that the canon file uses THIS EXACT eval question as its worked example, so assertions 1, 2, 3 and 4 may have been answered by reading the skill's own canon rather than by unaided reasoning over the evidence base. Assertion 6 (cites a repository file path) is also partly satisfied by that same canon path, although it independently cites PAPER2_CURRENT_DIRECTION_v2.1 and AGENT_RULES.md, which are genuine repository governance files outside the skill. The three failures (5, 7, 8) are the discriminating ones and are unaffected by the confound: even with canon access, the baseline did not emit the declaration line, did not use the closing Claim -> Evidence -> Limitation -> Next action block, and produced a 'specifies and validates' statement inconsistent with G2 not frozen / G3 execution not open. Treat the baseline's 5/8 as an upper bound on true unaided baseline performance.
